claim.claim-text: 1. A method of preparing a high-protein, acidified, liquid dairy product, comprising the steps of

a) providing a liquid composition - comprising a total amount of whey protein of at least 4% (w/w) of which at least 30%(w/w) is in the form of insoluble whey protein particles, - having volume weighted mean particle diameter, D[4,3], of at most 50 micron, - wherein at least 60% (w/w) of the total protein is whey protein,

b) subjecting the liquid composition of step a) to at least one acidification step using an acidifying agent and to at least one heat-treatment step in any order, thereby obtaining an acidified heat-treated liquid composition, c) optionally, homogenizing the acidified heat-treated liquid composition, and d) optionally, packaging an acidified dairy product derived from the acidified, heat-treated liquid composition of step b) or step c), wherein Ca<2+> and Mg<2+> cations are present prior to step b and/or added during or after step b) in an amount sufficient to obtain a weight ratio between the total amount of protein and the total amount of Ca<2+> and Mg<2+> cations of at most 100 in the acidified, heat-treated, liquid composition.
2. The method according to claim 1, wherein the total amount of whey protein is at least 6% (w/w).

3. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the whey protein comprises at least 40%(w/w) insoluble whey protein particles, preferably at least 50% (w/w), even more preferably at least 60% (w/w).

4. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the total amount of protein comprises at least 80% (w/w) whey protein, 85% (w/w) whey protein or even more preferably at least 90%(w/w) whey protein.
5. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the total amount of Ca<2+> and Mg<2+> cations is at least 100 mg/100 ml.
6. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the weight ratio between total protein and total amount of Ca<2+> and Mg<2+> cations is at most 90, preferably at most 50.
7. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the liquid composition of step a) furthermore comprises lipid.
8. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the liquid composition of step a) furthermore comprises carbohydrate.

9. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the at least one heat-treatment step of step b) comprises heating to a temperature of at least 60 degrees C for a duration sufficient to obtain at least a 5-log<10> reduction of viable Escherichia coli.
10. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the at least one heat treatment step comprises pre-acidification heat treatment and/or post acidification heat treatment.
11. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the acidifying agent comprises a bacterial culture and/or a chemical acidifying agent.
12. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the acidifying agent reduces pH of the liquid composition of step b) to a pH of at most 5.5.
13. A high-protein, acidified, liquid dairy product obtainable by the method according to any of claims 1-12.
14. A high-protein, acidified, liquid dairy product:

- comprising a total amount of whey protein of at least 4% (w/w) of which at least 30% is in the form of insoluble whey protein particles, - having volume weighted mean particle diameter, D[4,3], of at most 50 micron, - wherein at least 60% (w/w) of the total protein is whey protein, and - having a weight ratio between the total amount protein and the total amount of Ca<2+> and Mg<2+> cations of at most 100.
15. A high-protein, acidified, liquid dairy product according to claim 13 or 14, wherein the total amount of Ca<2+> and Mg<2+> cations is at least 100 mg/100 ml.
16. The high-protein, acidified, liquid dairy product according to any of the claims 13-15 having a viscosity of at most 2500cP at 5 degrees C at a shear rate of 300/s.

17. The high-protein, acidified, liquid dairy product according to any of claims 13-16, wherein the high-protein, acidified, liquid dairy product is yoghurt, such as e.g. a stirred yoghurt or a drinking yoghurt.
18. A protein/mineral powder

- comprising a total amount of at least 20% (w/w) whey protein of which at least 30% (w/w) is in the form of insoluble whey protein particles, - having volume weighted mean particle diameter, D[4,3], of at most 50 micron when suspended in water, - wherein at least 60% (w/w) of the total protein is whey protein, and - having a weight ratio between the total amount of protein and the total amount of Ca<2+> and Mg<2+> cations of at most 100.

19. Use of the protein/mineral powder according to claim 18 for producing a high-protein, acidified, liquid dairy product having a viscosity of at most 2500cP at 5 degrees C and at a shear rate of 300/s.
20. The use according to claim 19, wherein the high-protein, acidified, liquid dairy product:

- comprises a total amount of at least 4% (w/w) whey protein of which at least 30% is in the form of insoluble whey protein particles - has a volume weighted mean particle diameter, D[4,3], of at most 50 micron, and - has a weight ratio between the total amount of protein and the total amount of Ca<2+> and Mg<2+> cations of at most 100,
21. The use according to any of claims 19 or 20 wherein the high-protein, acidified, liquid dairy product comprises a total amount of Ca<2+> and Mg<2+> cations of at least 100 mg/100 ml.
